title: Complex Numbers as Map Moves Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
Ride 3 blocks east and 2 north, then 1 east and 4 north. Where are you? 4 east, 6 north: you added the east parts and the north parts separately. Adding complex numbers works exactly the same way. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 4, Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations) we add, subtract, multiply and divide complex numbers.

You will add part by part, watch two arrows join tip to tail on a live board as z2 changes, see subtraction as adding the opposite, compare adding (parts stay apart) with multiplying (every term meets every term), multiply the NCERT example (3 + 5i)(2 + 6i) step by step, watch multiplication by i turn an arrow a quarter turn, and check the NCERT formula for 1/z. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example that lands on a purely real answer, the exam trap of skipping the middle terms, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

In this video:
0:00 Two rides, one after the other
0:32 Adding complex numbers
0:53 Live: tip to tail on the board
1:22 Adding vs multiplying
1:50 Multiplying: the NCERT example
2:38 Multiplying by i: a quarter turn
3:10 Division and 1/z
3:34 Worked example
4:10 Exam trap: the middle terms
4:29 Where it is asked
4:41 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
5:14 Recap and three questions to answer

Next episode (Ep 41): Equality and Conjugates. A mirror image across the road.
